title: Genome-Wide Identification and Transcriptional Expression Profiles of Transcription Factor WRKY in Common Walnut (Juglans regia L.).
authors: Hao, Fan; Yang, Ge; Zhou, Huijuan; Yao, Jiajun; Liu, Deruilin; Zhao, Peng; Zhang, Shuoxin
one_liner_zh: 该文对核桃WRKY转录因子家族进行全基因组鉴定与表达谱分析，属于纯序列与转录组层面的基因家族研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题仅对象相关、方法无关。
abstract: The transcription factor WRKY is widely distributed in the plant kingdom, playing a significant role in plant growth, development and response to stresses. Walnut is an economically important temperate tree species valued for both its edible nuts and high-quality wood, and its response to various stresses is an important factor that determines the quality of its fruit. However, in walnut trees themselves, information about the WRKY gene family remains scarce. In this paper, we perform a comprehensive study of the WRKY gene family in walnut. In total, we identified 103 WRKY genes in the common walnut that are clustered into 4 groups and distributed on 14 chromosomes. The conserved domains all contained a WRKY domain, and motif 2 was observed in most WRKYs, suggesting a high degree of conservation and similar functions within each subfamily. However, gene structure was significantly differentiated between different subfamilies. Synteny analysis indicates that there were 56 gene pairs in J. regia and A. thaliana, 76 in J. regia and J. mandshurica, 75 in J. regia and J. microcarpa, 76 in J. regia and P. trichocarpa, and 33 in J. regia and Q. robur, indicating that the WRKY gene family may come from a common ancestor. GO and KEGG enrichment analysis showed that the WRKY gene family was involved in resistance traits and the plant-pathogen interaction pathway. In anthracnose-resistant F26 fruits (AR) and anthracnose-susceptible F423 fruits (AS), transcriptome and qPCR analysis results showed that JrWRKY83, JrWRKY73 and JrWRKY74 were expressed significantly more highly in resistant cultivars, indicating that these three genes may be important contributors to stress resistance in walnut trees. Furthermore, we investigate how these three genes potentially target miRNAs and interact with proteins. JrWRKY73 was target by the miR156 family, including 12 miRNAs; this miRNA family targets WRKY genes to enhance plant defense. JrWRKY73 also interacted with the resistance gene AtMPK6, showing that it may play a crucial role in walnut defense.
abstract_zh: 转录因子WRKY在植物界广泛分布，在植物生长、发育及逆境响应中发挥重要作用。核桃是一种经济上重要的温带树种，因其可食用坚果和优质木材而备受重视，其对各种逆境的响应是决定果实品质的重要因素。然而，在核桃树本身中，关于WRKY基因家族的信息仍然匮乏。本文对核桃中的WRKY基因家族进行了全面研究。我们共鉴定出103个普通核桃中的WRKY基因，这些基因聚为4组，分布于14条染色体上。保守结构域均包含一个WRKY结构域，且大多数WRKY中观察到基序2，表明各亚家族内具有高度保守性和相似功能。然而，不同亚家族之间的基因结构存在显著分化。共线性分析表明，J. regia与A. thaliana之间存在56对基因，J. regia与J. mandshurica之间为76对，J. regia与J. microcarpa之间为75对，J. regia与P. trichocarpa之间为76对，J. regia与Q. robur之间为33对，这表明WRKY基因家族可能源自共同祖先。GO和KEGG富集分析显示，WRKY基因家族参与抗性性状及植物-病原体互作通路。在抗炭疽病F26果实（AR）和易感炭疽病F423果实（AS）中，转录组和qPCR分析结果显示，JrWRKY83、JrWRKY73和JrWRKY74在抗性品种中表达显著更高，表明这三个基因可能是核桃树抗逆性的重要贡献者。此外，我们研究了这三个基因如何潜在靶向miRNA并与蛋白质互作。JrWRKY73被miR156家族靶向，该家族包含12个miRNA；此miRNA家族通过靶向WRKY基因增强植物防御。JrWRKY73还与抗性基因AtMPK6互作，表明其可能在核桃防御中发挥关键作用。
